privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p_data: We process: name, phone and/or email, visit and reward history, card language.
privacy.p_purpose: Purpose: running the loyalty program (stamps, rewards, appointment reminders).

privacy.p_retention: We keep the data while you are in the program; after deletion only anonymous statistics remain.
privacy.p_rights: You have the right to access, correct, delete and port your data. Just ask the salon in person or by phone.
privacy.p_processor: The service is technically operated by {{app}} as the salon's processor.
privacy.template_note: Template – have it reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
